# Original combat atlas

combat-atlas.png was generated specifically for RE:COMMAND in this development session. No Everplanet images were copied. Four rows contain sword crescents, player energy rings, monster claw strikes, and guardian pulses; each row has four frames. Runtime cell extraction is performed by vfx.js. The texture is mapped to world-space surfaces and combined with animated 3D geometry. This is not a 3D character model or a change to combat hit detection.
